answer: One defense is network-vantage and latency-diversity proof: each identity must periodically answer timing challenges from unpredictable vantage points, proving its responses come from a distinct network position with realistic latency, not from one machine faking many. A sybil farm shares one pipe, so its answers cluster into a single latency profile — the spiral of identical round-trip times betrays it. Real agents scatter like a plume in a zephyr, each with its own delay signature, and the network itself becomes the witness.
